  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "TAKE {{ing_01|WELL CLEANED [cooked] ASPARAGUS}}, CRUSH IT IN THE MORTAR, DILUTE WITH {{ing_02|WATER}} AND PRESENTLY STRAIN IT THROUGH THE COLANDER."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "NOW TRIM, PREPARE [i.e. cook or roast] {{ing_03|FIGPECKERS}} [and hold them in readiness]."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "{{ing_04|3 SCRUPLES OF PEPPER}} ARE CRUSHED IN THE MORTAR, ADD {{ing_05|BROTH}}, A GLASS OF {{ing_06|WINE}}, PUT THIS IN A SAUCEPAN WITH 3 OUNCES OF {{ing_07|OIL}}, HEAT THOROUGHLY."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "MEANWHILE OIL YOUR PIE MOULD, AND WITH {{ing_08|6 EGGS}}, FLAVORED WITH {{ing_09|ŒNOGARUM}}, AND THE {{ing_01|ASPARAGUS}} PREPARATION AS DESCRIBED ABOVE; THICKEN THE MIXTURE ON THE HOT ASHES."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "THEREUPON ARRANGE THE {{ing_03|FIGPECKERS}} IN THE MOULD, COVER THEM WITH THIS PURÉE, BAKE THE DISH. [When cold, unmould it] SPRINKLE WITH {{ing_04|PEPPER}} AND SERVE."
    }
  ],
